Does Window Film Qualify for Arizona Energy Rebates?

Yes. Both SRP Business Solutions and APS Peak Player programs offer energy efficiency rebates for qualifying window film installations in Arizona. Ceramic and spectrally selective films with documented SHGC ratings are eligible — not all film types qualify.

SRP Business Solutions Rebate

SRP Business Solutions offers rebates for commercial window film installations that meet specific energy efficiency thresholds. Qualifying films must have NFRC-rated SHGC values that demonstrate measurable solar heat gain reduction.

We provide the required NFRC technical data sheets, installation documentation, and assist with the SRP rebate application for commercial properties across the Phoenix metro.

APS Energy Efficiency Rebate

APS offers energy efficiency rebates for both residential and commercial window film installations. The program rewards property owners who reduce peak cooling demand through qualifying energy improvements including window film.

We handle the NFRC documentation and provide the paid invoice and installation proof required for APS rebate submissions.

Which Films Qualify for Rebates

Not all window films qualify for energy rebates. Qualifying films must have documented SHGC ratings from NFRC-certified testing:

  • Ceramic films — most ceramic films with SHGC ≤ 0.25 qualify
  • Spectrally selective films — high VLT with aggressive SHGC ratings qualify
  • Low-E films — EnerLogic and similar dual-season films with qualifying SHGC
  • Dyed and carbon films — typically do not qualify due to insufficient SHGC performance

Frequently Asked Questions

Does window film qualify for SRP rebates in Arizona?

Yes. SRP Business Solutions offers rebates for qualifying window film installations on commercial properties. Eligible films must meet specific SHGC ratings. We provide the NFRC-rated technical data sheets required for rebate applications and identify qualifying films during your free estimate.

Does window film qualify for APS energy rebates?

Yes. APS offers energy efficiency rebates for qualifying window film installations. We provide NFRC documentation and assist with the APS rebate application process for both residential and commercial projects.

How much can I save with SRP or APS window film rebates?

Rebate amounts vary by program, film type, and square footage. Combined with reduced cooling costs of $250–$725 annually, qualifying rebates can significantly reduce payback period. Ask about current rebate amounts during your free estimate.

What documentation is needed for a window film rebate?

NFRC-rated technical data sheets showing the film's SHGC rating, visible light transmission, and UV rejection are required. You'll also need proof of professional installation and a paid invoice. We provide all technical documentation and assist with the application process.
